recordedFrom: prava-theme — the site adopts the Prava identity as its one palette. Until now src/styles/tokens.css was blue-cast and src/design-system/tokens.css was green-cast, so a reader moving between a page and the gallery saw two products. Both files now carry identical neutrals and the same teal primary, controls take the pill shape, and the mono voice comes from --font-mono. This baseline exists to catch a design-system change LEAKING into the site; here the site was changed on purpose, so the hashes are re-recorded rather than the change reverted. Every G-C1/G-C2 contrast pair was recomputed and passes in both themes.
note: sha256 of every built route document.
